label: RFC-0013 §4: DataFusion vs DuckDB on net_balances over one sealed segment
query: net_balances - the i128 signed fold over a string-typed uint256 value column
note: each size run twice, reversing engine order, because the first engine warms the page cache
parity: identical results at every size, in both orders
verdict: gate not met - DataFusion is 1.6-2.7x DuckDB's latency and the gap widens with segment size
decision: keep DuckDB in embedded; do not adopt DataFusion for 1.0
